kings2.9.p1.b1.text: Tuck your cloak under your belt, take this flask of oil, and go to Ramoth-gilead.

kings2.9.p1.b2.text: When you arrive, look for Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi. Go in, get him away from his companions, and take him to an inner room.

kings2.9.p1.b3.text: Then take the flask of oil, pour it on his head, and declare, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’ Then open the door and run. Do not delay!”

kings2.9.p2.b1.text: So the young prophet went to Ramoth-gilead,

kings2.9.p2.b2.text: I have a message for you, commander

kings2.9.p2.b4.text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anoint you king over the LORD’s people Israel.

kings2.9.p3.b1.text: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, … And on the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour Jezebel, and there will be no one to bury her.

kings2.9.p3.b2.text: Is everything all right? Why did this madman come to you?

kings2.9.p3.b3.text: He talked to me about this and that, and he said, ‘This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.’

kings2.9.p4.b1.text: Thus Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram.

kings2.9.p4.b2.text: If you commanders wish to make me king, then do not let anyone escape from the city to go and tell it in Jezreel.

kings2.9.p4.b3.text: I see a company of troops!

kings2.9.p4.b4.text: What do you know about peace? … Fall in behind me.

kings2.9.p5.b1.text: He reached them, but he is not coming back.

kings2.9.p5.b2.text: And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi —he is driving like a madman!

kings2.9.p6.b2.text: Have you come in peace, Jehu?

kings2.9.p6.b3.text: How can there be peace … as long as the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?

kings2.9.p7.b1.text: Then Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders. The arrow pierced his heart, and he slumped down in his chariot.

kings2.9.p7.b2.text: Pick him up and throw him into the field of Naboth the Jezreelite. For remember … ‘As surely as I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons yesterday, declares the LORD, so will I repay you on this plot of ground, declares the LORD.’ …

kings2.9.p7.b4.text: Then his servants carried him by chariot to Jerusalem and buried him with his fathers in his tomb in the City of David. … In the eleventh year of Joram son of Ahab, Ahaziah had become king over Judah.

kings2.9.p8.b1.text: Now when Jehu arrived in Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it. So she painted her eyes, adorned her head, and looked down from a window.

kings2.9.p8.b2.text: Have you come in peace, O Zimri, murderer of your master?

kings2.9.p9.b3.text: So they threw her down, and her blood splattered on the wall and on the horses as they trampled her underfoot.

kings2.9.p9.b4.text: Take care of this cursed woman … and bury her, for she was the daughter of a king.

kings2.9.p10.b1.text: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing but her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.

kings2.9.p10.b2.text: This is the word of the LORD, which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite …

kings2.9.p10.b3.text: ‘On the plot of ground at Jezreel the dogs will devour the flesh of Jezebel. And Jezebel’s body will lie like dung in the field on the plot of ground at Jezreel, so that no one can say: This is Jezebel.’
